anomalies.observed: On the NAVC Peripherals sheet, the TMP100 (U1) SDA pin carries the global label NET0053. NET0053 appears only at this one pin. The actual NAVC I2C SDA bus is NET0052, which is used by every other device on that bus (U18 BMI088 pin 9, U4 IIS2MDCTR pin 4, U16 MPRLS pin 2, U6 EEPROM pin 3) and is the net tied to the +3V3 through the I2C pull-up resistors (R29/R84/R18/R39). U1's SCL is correctly on NET0078.
anomalies.expected: The TMP100 SDA pin should be on the same net as the rest of the NAVC I2C SDA bus (NET0052) so the device can be addressed. The spec lists TMP100 as an I2C peripheral at address 0x4E on the NAVC bus.

evidence.quote: NAVC Peripherals sheet, U1 TMP100: SDA pin label 'NET0053'; U18 BMI088 SDA/SDI 'NET0052', U4 IIS2MDCTR SDA 'NET0052', U16 MPRLS MOSI/SDA 'NET0052', U6 EEPROM SDA 'NET0052'; I2C pull-ups to +3V3 on 'NET0078'/'NET0052'.
Temperature sensor | NAVCPeripherals | TMP100, I2C addr 0x4E

anomalies.impact: The temperature sensor's data line is not joined to the I2C bus (NET0053 is a single-pin, dead net), so the TMP100 cannot be addressed or read; the barometer/IMU/magnetometer/EEPROM remain on NET0052 and are unaffected.

parsed.summary: The board matches the specification almost everywhere (power rails, MCUs, sensor set, I2C addresses, the documented barometer RESET/EOC swap, and the PCA9685 address set to 0x41 to avoid the INA219 0x40 conflict are all consistent). The one deviation supported by the drawing is that the TMP100 (U1) SDA pin is labeled NET0053 instead of the NAVC I2C SDA bus NET0052, leaving its data line disconnected from the bus.
